name: B10-0406/2026 – After § 3 – Am 21
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recent hybrid attacks and instrumentalisation of migrants in Ceuta and the need for a coordinated response to protect the EU’s external borders
part_text: 3a. Recalls that the European Court of Human Rights judgment of 13 February 2020 in the case of N.D. and N.T. v Spain (8675/15and8697/15) is premised on the existence of genuine and effective access to legal means of entry and to international protection at official border crossing points; calls on Spain to guarantee such access and to ensure that everyone who expresses a wish to seek asylum is registered and given an individual examination;
